info.title: Global Router API
info.description: Managing Global Router: organizing network connectivity between products, services, and servers in different pools

tags.name: Routers
tags.description: Represents the core routing devices connecting networks across services and zones. Routers are the points where networks are attached, and where static routes are applied to shape traffic between zones and services.

tags.name: Networks
tags.description: Defines logical networks allocated to products and services, enabling isolation and routing within the infrastructure. If a network is connected to a router, it exists in both Global Router service and its original service, and can be managed separately.  For example, you can delete a cloud platform network in Global Router service without deleting it from the cloud platform, it will disconnect the cloud platform network from the router. Each network is created within a zone, can host multiple subnets, and is connected via a router.

tags.name: Subnets
tags.description: Specifies subnetworks within a network — used to segment traffic, allocate IP ranges and manage routing in an L3 VPN context. Same as network, it exists in both Global Router service and its original service, and can be managed separately. Static routes may reference subnets as destinations.

tags.name: Static routes
tags.description: Captures manually configured routing entries used to direct traffic between networks and zones via specific addresses.

tags.name: Services
tags.description: Represents a scope of products and services using the same network infrastructure.  For example, the `vpc` service represents cloud servers, load balancers, file storage, Managed Kubernetes, and Managed Databases.

tags.name: Zones
tags.description: Represents a logical grouping of network resources that are used by a service or a product within one pool.  For example, cloud platform networks in the `ru-3` pool belong to the `ru-3` zone. Zones are logically aggregated into Zone Groups.

tags.name: Zone groups
tags.description: Logical association of zones. A router can only connect networks of the same zone group.

tags.name: Quotas
tags.description: Provides quotas for resources (routers, networks, subnets, static routes) within the Global Router service.
